title: Chapter 109 Control Methods
content:
Chapter 109 Control Methods

Wu Qing quickly produced two thousand sets of popular version of reproductive equipment at the Zerg base underground in the new city of Daxia, and asked his personal guards to get them.

When Wu Cong took the small black ball-shaped biological reproductive equipment in his hand, it was bound with blood on the spot. The original small black ball proliferated and grew instantly, transforming into a set of plain armor.

He stretched out his right hand, and a sword was quickly generated in his hand, just like the one printed by the 3D printer in Wu Qing's original world.

Since the wizard bound the biological reproductive equipment, he has learned more about the biological reproductive equipment. He continuously inputs his own energy into the biological reproductive equipment, speeding up the proliferation of the biological reproductive equipment, and strengthening the various abilities of the biological reproductive equipment.

As for injecting luck into biological reproductive equipment, you need to use luck beads or go into battle with biological reproductive equipment to kill the enemy and plunder the enemy's luck during the battle.

An individual's own luck cannot be controlled independently. Its increase or decrease is determined by the combined influence of many factors. It cannot be used to bless items or be given to others.

Wu Cong stretched out his left hand, and an exquisite arm crossbow was generated. As long as he thought, sharp crossbow arrows made of biological materials could be fired.

Wu Cong changed the pattern and tested it for a while, then stopped. He was very satisfied with the performance of the biological reproductive equipment.

"Wucong, there are a total of two thousand sets of biological reproduction equipment here. You can use them to form Daxia's new army!"

"Thank you for your hard work in exploring the use of new equipment and forming combat effectiveness as soon as possible!"

"Time waits not for us, we will go to war soon!"

"I hope to see you there then!"

Wu Qing gave two thousand sets of biological reproduction equipment to Wu Cong and asked Wu Cong to form a new army for Daxia.

The army Wu Qing wants to form requires at least the strength of a human wanderer to be eligible to join.

These human wanderers have gone through many hardships and now after recovery, the weakest ones have one star rating.

It can be said that they are the group of people with the strongest average strength under Wu Qing.

Wu Qing does not need cannon fodder. Zerg puppies are much easier to use than cannon fodder. Those who are not strong enough in Daxia Territory might as well stay in Daxia Territory and engage in construction.

In addition, other territories in the alliance will provide a large number of ordinary troops, so there is no need for Daxia Territory to build another ordinary army.

In the future, the main force of the Daxia Territory, and even the entire alliance, in external operations will still be the Zerg. Except for some really strong elite troops, other ordinary troops will only be assigned to the Zerg.

…

Wu Cong took the order to form a new army, and Wu Qing called Hu Tu.

Hu Tu, who had not seen Wu Qing for a while, was very happy to see Wu Qing. Wu Qing was in a good mood when he saw Hu Tu who was growing up rapidly.

Wu Qing asked Hu Tu some things about work, study and life, and Hu Tu answered them one by one. Seeing that Hu Tu was still a little reserved, Wu Qing stopped talking and started to arrange work matters for Hu Tu.

"Hu Tu, arrange your manpower to immediately authenticate the identity of the two thousand human races and the more than fifty thousand newly arrived citizens."

"The two thousand humans are about to start forming a new army. You must fully cooperate with the witch followers to establish the new army as soon as possible."

"More than 50,000 new residents will all participate in the construction of the new city, and priority will be given to building residential areas and military barracks."

"Now that the territory has a larger population, you must study hard and make progress at a rate that can keep up with the territory's development!"

"..."

Wu Qing arranged a task for Hu Tu and chatted for a while before letting Hu Tu go about his business.

The reason why Wu Qing wants to train Hu Tu is because he needs some trustworthy people in this world, and Hu Tu is very suitable.

In the original world, the system had no scruples. Anyone who joined Wu Qing's camp could lock in his camp, check his loyalty, and easily distinguish between loyal and traitorous people.

People's loyalty can also be increased through various methods. When the loyalty reaches the full value of 100, you can be locked into a die-hard member and never betray.

Wu Qing's subordinates are basically die-hard personnel with 100 loyalty. Coupled with a large number of system personnel and the existence of Ark's super intelligence brain, he does not have to worry about the management of his forces at all.

Later, the entire world realized intelligent management, and Wu Qing became the person behind the scenes of the world who didn't have to worry about anything.

When we came to this world, the system's functions were completely restricted. Apart from providing a Zerg base and assisting in the conversion of resources, there were no other functions.

People in this world have no loyalty to check. People's hearts are full of different attitudes and it's impossible to guard against them. Wu Qing had to use some means.

Wu Qing knew very well that father and son would turn against each other. Just relying on favors and training was not so reliable. His real method was the technological power of the Zerg.

Biological reproductive equipment, identity tags, identity authentication spores and parasites are all living Zerg units. If necessary, Wu Qing and the Queen can control them immediately through the Zerg information network.

Even tiny and undetectable spores can transmit energy through the Zerg information network, instantly evolving the spores into various terrifying Zerg units.

Wu Qing and the Insect Queen want to use them to do other things, which is of course even easier.

Spores and parasites are both combat tools for high-level Zerg units. The current Zerg can only use them simply. When more technologies are unlocked and more powerful Zerg units appear, perhaps an invisible spore will be spread out. Can destroy a territory.

By then, the Zerg would have become a strange and terrifying existence.

With the assistance of these means, Wu Qing's management of people other than the Zerg will be much simpler.

Future alliances will also be gradually incorporated into this management system, and then the entire alliance will be truly under Wu Qing's control.

Some means do not have to be used, but they must be used.

...

After everything was arranged, Wu Qing went to see the construction of the new city.

The materials transported from the alliance city have been transported to the underground warehouse by the Zerg worker bees day and night.

A large number of warehouses that were urgently rebuilt underground in the new city are full of materials. With the supply of these materials, most of the materials in Daxia Territory are now not lacking.

Wu Qing plans to use weapons and equipment materials to exchange some city-building materials with various territories of the alliance. After the large framework of the city is built, there are still many details to be done, and a lot of various resources are needed.

These resources can be mined by themselves, but the speed of obtaining them through trading is definitely faster.

After Wu Qing asked two thousand Zerg worker bees to transport the materials, they helped build the city wall together for a day. Now the city wall of the new city has basically taken shape.

The construction of the residential area has also been partially completed. Because a large number of new people have joined the Great Xia Territory, the residential area needs to be further accelerated.

With the addition of more than 50,000 parasites, the construction speed of the new city in the Great Xia Territory will definitely continue to increase.
